rationale: C03 plausibly supplied a material drafting template for the child letter. Both directives identify an unresolved stabilization problem involving existing institutions, ask responsible officials to study “ways and means” of reconciling or administering overlapping functions, request recommendations, and prescribe interim conduct while permanent machinery is being considered. C08 is closely related to the child’s railway-dispute subject and emergency-board mechanism, but its formal Railway Labor Act boilerplate and operative sequence are less similar to the child letter as a whole. C06 concerns wage-stabilization administration but lacks the child’s study-plus-interim-panel structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I wish that you would examine ways and means by which the officials now responsible for the settlement of labor disputes... [could administer] the wage stabilization program in that industry... I ask that you submit to me your views and recommendations on the general matter.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am requesting the Secretary of the Treasury, the Chairman of the Federal Reserve Board, the Director of Defense Mobilization, and the Chairman of the Council of Economic Advisers to study ways and means to provide the necessary restraint on private credit expansion and at the same time to make it possible to maintain stability in the market for Government securities.
shared_material.explanation: Both use the distinctive formulation of directing named officials to study “ways and means” of combining two governmental objectives and return recommendations.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In the meantime, it is essential that some interim machinery be established... Accordingly, I am asking that you immediately establish an emergency panel...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: While this study is underway, I hope that no attempt will be made to change the interest rate pattern... I should like you to consider also the establishment of a committee similar to the Capital Issues Committee of World War I...
shared_material.explanation: Both pair a longer-term institutional study with interim instructions and consideration or establishment of a committee-like mechanism.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Considerable care will have to be taken in devising sound and workable procedures and organizational relationships. The task is to facilitate administration... and use to the best advantage the existing resources of the National Mediation Board.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: We have effective agencies for considering this problem and arriving at a proper solution... Over the years, a number of important steps have been taken towards developing effective machinery for consistent and comprehensive national economic policies.
shared_material.explanation: Both frame the assignment as adapting existing agencies and administrative machinery to coordinate overlapping stabilization responsibilities.
